title: Recorded UK imports: beef and veal (HS 0201, 0202)
coverage: UK recorded imports from all partners (EU and non-EU import flows); GB and Northern Ireland
attribution: Source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics (uktradeinfo). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

retrieval.method: HMRC OTS API, server-side $apply aggregation; raw responses cached in pipeline/raw/hmrc/
retrieval.source: 2 queries over consecutive runs of the basket's CN8 codes (at most ten codes per query), first: https://api.uktradeinfo.com/OTS?$apply=filter(MonthId%20ge%20201901%20and%20(FlowTypeId%20eq%201%20or%20FlowTypeId%20eq%203)%20and%20(CommodityId%20eq%202011000%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202012020%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202012030%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202012050%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202012090%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202013000%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202021000%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202022010%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202022030%20or%20CommodityId%20eq%202022050))/groupby((MonthId,FlowTypeId,CountryId,CommodityId,SuppressionIndex),aggregate(NetMass%20with%20sum%20as%20SumNetMass,Value%20with%20sum%20as%20SumValue,$count%20as%20Rows))
retrieval.notes: CN8 codes: 02011000, 02012020, 02012030, 02012050, 02012090, 02013000, 02021000, 02022010, 02022030, 02022050, 02022090, 02023010, 02023050, 02023090. Import flows 1 (EU) and 3 (non-EU) summed. Partner = country of dispatch recorded by HMRC. Suppressed trade kept separately. Latest month confirmed by probing the following month. Months from provisionalFrom are within HMRC's 18-month revision window (estimated from publication lag).
